name: findgolfsuppliers-finder
description: Find suppliers to golf courses, driving ranges, pro shops and indoor golf venues listed on Find Golf Suppliers, by need and place, ordered by match and distance.

interface.longDescription:
Find golf trade suppliers from the listings published on Find Golf Suppliers, a directory of suppliers to golf courses, driving ranges, pro shops, golf clubs and indoor golf venues. Describe what you need, such as mowers and turf equipment, golf carts, irrigation, driving range equipment, commercial golf simulators, course architects or tee time software, and optionally a town, city, state or country. Results are ordered by how well each listing matches and how close it is, never by payment, and each result links to its listing page on Find Golf Suppliers.

Limitations: only businesses listed on Find Golf Suppliers are searched; summaries are the directory's published descriptions; contact details are on each listing page.
defaultPrompt: Golf course mowers and turf equipment near Toronto
Commercial golf simulator installers in the UK

positive.prompt: Golf course mowers and turf equipment suppliers near Toronto
positive.expected_behavior: Lists turf equipment suppliers within about 60 miles of Toronto, nearest best matches first, each with distance and a link to its listing.

positive.prompt: Golf cart dealers in Florida for our club fleet
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Florida golf cart dealers with towns and listing links.

positive.prompt: Commercial golf simulator installers in the UK
positive.expected_behavior: Lists UK commercial simulator installers and fit-out companies with listing links.

positive.prompt: Golf course architects and construction companies in the UK
positive.expected_behavior: Lists UK golf course design and construction businesses with listing links.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first one
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the published summary, categories, location and listing link for that supplier.

negative.prompt: How do I stop slicing my driver?
Book me a tee time at St Andrews tomorrow.
What is the capital of Australia?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments; it links to directory listing pages.

publication.release_notes: First release: golf trade supplier search by need and place (city, state or country); category list; one listing in detail. Read-only tools.
